summary: 75-year-old Jennifer Hearn reported overdue ~8:39 p.m. after not returning from a hike on Triangle Peak (hikes it 3-4x/week; vehicle at trailhead). MRA searched 8:57 p.m.-2:40 a.m. June 9-10; resumed June 10 8:17 a.m. with 30 MRA members, Flight for Life helicopter, DFPC multi-mission aircraft, and a SARDUS dog team. June 11 search with 30 MRA members, Care Flight of the Rockies helicopter, and citizens; her dog Tawny found ~9:30 a.m. at a residence near the peak, narrowing the search; Jennifer found alive ~3:15 p.m. June 11 in the scree fields and given medical care.
location: Triangle Peak Trail, Snowmass Canyon area of the Roaring Fork Valley, off Lower River Rd
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Mountain Rescue Aspen; Flight for Life; Care Flight of the Rockies; Colorado Division of Fire Prevention and Control; Search and Rescue Dogs of the United States
notes: DATE OF INCIDENT June 9, 2024 (Sunday-verified) per PCSO newsflash case 24P006586; both release URLs parent-opened in run 642. [run 705: SnowBrains corroboration parent-opened — confirms Jennifer Hearn found alive ~3:15 p.m. June 11, carried out on stretcher for medical care; SnowBrains reports age 74 vs row's 75 per PCSO]
